description: Check whether a package actually exists and is safe to install. Returns existence, latest version, deprecation status, security advisory count, and a `suspicious` flag when the name resembles a popular package but behaves like a typosquat (no repository, placeholder version, one release). Call this before running any install command for a package you have not verified in this session -- LLM-generated package names are a known malware vector.

ecosystem.description: Which package registry the package lives in.

name.description: Package name exactly as it would be installed.

name: check_package
title: Verify a package before installing
